references.context: Category theory: general possibly large category with objects and morphisms
references.reason: The only indexed general category meaning is explicitly small; avoid imposing unwarranted smallness.

references.phrase: morphisms B to A and B to C
references.context: Category theory: diagram of two arrows with a common source object
references.reason: The categorical span shape and its arrow family require contextual matching.

references.phrase: morphisms A to P and C to P agreeing on B
references.context: Category theory: cocone under a span B→A and B→C
references.reason: Compatible arrows defining the pushout cocone are not yet linked to an independent cocone meaning.

references.phrase: every other compatible pair factors uniquely
references.context: Category theory: universal property of a colimit cocone of span shape
references.reason: Uniqueness of the induced arrow is the universal-property clause.

references.disposition: P is the defined output object; it is not itself an additional missing contextual meaning.

review_rationale: Reviewed the pushout universal property of the cospan of arrows B→A and B→C and retained span/cocone and universal factorization references without assuming all categories are small.
